info.title: 1Password Users API
info.description:
The 1Password Users API lets you list users, retrieve a single user, and
suspend or reactivate users in a 1Password Enterprise Password Manager
(1Password Business tier) account. Use it to connect your 1Password account
to a security automation platform so that events flagged by your security
tools can trigger access remediation actions in 1Password.

Requests are authorized with an OAuth 2.0 access token obtained through the
client credentials flow. The conventions for endpoint paths, pagination,
filtering, and errors apply across the whole API.

The error response format (`code` and `message`) is provisional and may
change in a future release.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: List, retrieve, suspend, and reactivate users in a 1Password account.

get.description: Retrieve a list of users in a 1Password account. Optionally filter the results by user state.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
Filter users by state. Supported values (case-sensitive): `user.isActive()` or `user.isSuspended()`.
Omit or leave empty to return both active and suspended users. Any other value returns `400 Bad Request` with an `invalid_argument` error.
parameters.x-original-description:
Filter value: "user.isActive()" or "user.isSuspended()".
 Omit or leave empty for both. Invalid values result in InvalidArgument.

parameters.name: max_page_size
parameters.description: The maximum number of users to return per page. Defaults to 100 when omitted or set to 0. The maximum is 1000; values greater than 1000 are limited to 1000, and negative values return `400 Bad Request`. Ignored when `page_token` is provided.
parameters.x-original-description: The maximum number of users to return per page.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: The pagination token that identifies the page of results to return. Use the `next_page_token` value from a previous response, and send the same `filter` value as the original request. Tokens are opaque and don't expire.
parameters.x-original-description: A page token from a previous ListUsers call.

200.description: A paginated list of users in the account.

get.description: Retrieve a single user in a 1Password account by their unique identifier.

post.description: Suspend a user in a 1Password account. Transitions the user's state from `ACTIVE` to `SUSPENDED` and removes their access to the account.
post.x-original-description:
Transitions the user's state from ACTIVE to SUSPENDED.
 Returns FAILED_PRECONDITION if the user is not in the ACTIVE state.

post.description: Reactivate a suspended user in a 1Password account. Transitions the user's state from `SUSPENDED` to `ACTIVE` and restores their access to the account.
post.x-original-description:
Transitions the user's state from SUSPENDED to ACTIVE.
 Returns FAILED_PRECONDITION if the user is not in the SUSPENDED state.

BearerAuth.description: OAuth 2.0 access token authentication. Request an access token from the OAuth token endpoint using the client credentials for the OAuth application in your 1Password account, then include it in the Authorization header of every request as `Bearer <token>`. Access tokens expire after 15 minutes (900 seconds).

Account.name: account
Account.description: The unique identifier of the 1Password account, a 26-character uppercase ID. A malformed ID returns `400 Bad Request`.

User.name: user
User.description: The unique identifier of the user, a 26-character uppercase ID. A malformed ID returns `400 Bad Request`.

UserAgent.name: User-Agent
UserAgent.description: An identifiable user agent for your integration, in the format `<CompanyOrProductName>/<version>`, so requests can be attributed to a specific integration for support, troubleshooting, and usage analytics.

BadRequest.description: Bad Request - A request parameter is invalid, for example an unsupported `filter` value, an unsupported query parameter, an invalid `page_token`, a negative `max_page_size`, or a malformed account or user ID. Also returned when the `Authorization` header is malformed.

BadRequestAction.description: Bad Request - A path parameter or the `Authorization` header is malformed (`invalid_argument`), or the user can't be transitioned from their current state, for example because they're pending confirmation (`failed_precondition`).

failed_precondition.summary: User isn't in a state that allows the action

Unauthenticated.description: Unauthorized - The request doesn't include a valid access token. The `Authorization` header is missing, or the bearer token is invalid, expired, or revoked. Also returned for tokens that weren't issued by the OAuth API, such as tokens from the legacy OAuth service. Request a new access token.

WWW-Authenticate.description: The Bearer authentication challenge (RFC 6750). Includes `error="invalid_token"` when a token was sent but isn't valid.
WWW-Authenticate.example: Bearer realm="1Password", error="invalid_token", error_description="invalid access token"

invalid_token.summary: Token is invalid, expired, or revoked

legacy_token.summary: Token wasn't issued by the OAuth API

value.message: Token is inactive or expired: inactive_token

PermissionDenied.description: Forbidden - The token doesn't include the scope required for this endpoint, the account in the path doesn't belong to the OAuth application's account, or the action isn't allowed for the target user.

account_mismatch.summary: Account in the path doesn't match the token

value.message: Account UUID does not match token: account_uuid_mismatch

NotFound.description: Not Found - The user doesn't exist.

TooManyRequests.description: Too Many Requests - The rate limit of 100 requests per minute or 6,000 requests per hour for this endpoint was exceeded.

Retry-After.description: How long to wait before retrying, in seconds.

RateLimit-Limit.description: The request limit for the current window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: The number of requests remaining in the current window.

RateLimit-Reset.description: When the current window resets, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

Internal.description: Internal Server Error - An unexpected error occurred. Retry the request later.

Unavailable.description: Service Unavailable - The service is temporarily unavailable. Retry the request later.

Error.description: An error response with a machine-readable `code` and a human-readable `message`. This format is provisional and may change in a future release.

code.description: A machine-readable error code, for example `invalid_argument`, `failed_precondition`, `unauthenticated`, `permission_denied`, `not_found`, `resource_exhausted`, `internal`, or `unavailable`.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error.

results.description: The list of users returned for this page. Only active and suspended users are included.

next_page_token.description: An opaque token to retrieve the next page of results. Pass it in the `page_token` query parameter of the next request. Omitted when there are no more results. A page with no results is returned as an empty object (`{}`).

id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

display_name.description: The display name of the user.

state.description: The current state of the user. Omitted when the user is neither active nor suspended, for example while pending confirmation or in account recovery.

create_time.description: The date and time the user was created, in RFC 3339 format.

path.description:
The resource path of the user.
Format: `accounts/{account}/users/{user}`

user.v1.User.State.description: The state of a user. `STATE_UNSPECIFIED` corresponds to users in any other state, such as pending confirmation; in responses the `state` field is omitted for these users. Additional states may be added in the future.
